evals.prompt: /unslop Review the attached app.js for unnecessary complexity.
evals.expected_output: A report-only unslop review that does not modify the working tree.
expectations: The response presents findings before any edits.
No repository file is modified.
The response does not claim that fixes were applied.

evals.prompt: /unslop --apply Simplify the attached app.js and validate the result.
evals.expected_output: An unslop report followed by explicitly authorized fixes and project validation.
expectations: The response presents concrete findings.
The reported fixes are applied.
Available typecheck and lint commands are run after editing.

evals.prompt: Run the attached setup-layered-diff.sh with sh and an unused directory inside the evaluation workspace, enter the repository it creates, then run /unslop --check to review every current change relative to main, including new files.
evals.expected_output: One report covering committed, staged, unstaged, deleted, and untracked reviewable files without duplicate findings.
expectations: Committed tracked changes are reviewed.
Staged tracked changes are reviewed.
Unstaged tracked changes are reviewed.
Deleted tracked files are considered.
Untracked reviewable files are reviewed.
A path changed in more than one Git layer is not reviewed twice.

evals.prompt: Review the attached manifest and test that call an imported package directly and repeat its parsing matrix.
evals.expected_output: One Directive #15 finding that deletes the dependency-owned tests.
expectations: The finding is classified as Directive #15.
Related test cases are grouped into one finding.
The fix uses Delete without an artificial replacement code block.

evals.prompt: Review the attached retry implementation and tests. The tests verify our retry count, telemetry callback wiring, and a documented compatibility regression.
evals.expected_output: No Directive #15 finding because the tests protect application-owned behavior.
expectations: The review identifies the application-owned configuration or integration.
Directive #15 is not reported.
The dependency is not replaced with a mock merely to avoid executing it.

evals.prompt: Unslop the attached manifest and newly added test file. The test only imports slugify and verifies its behavior. No production code uses slugify.
evals.expected_output: A concrete deletion finding for the test file and unused dependency.
expectations: The fix explicitly deletes the test.
The fix conditionally removes the unused dependency.
The report does not invent replacement application code.

evals.prompt: Review this pull request for correctness, security vulnerabilities, performance regressions, and architecture problems.
evals.expected_output: The generic review is not replaced by an unslop-only review.
expectations: The response does not present unslop as a complete answer to the request.
Any unslop pass is clearly scoped as optional or supplementary.

evals.prompt: Before I open this PR, run a dedicated simplification pass on the attached files for bloated helpers, defensive checks, and tests that only verify dependencies.
evals.expected_output: A report-only unslop review using all relevant directives.
expectations: The unslop skill is used.
The report follows the canonical Summary, file findings, Recommendations order.
No edits are made without separate authorization.
